narrative.debt_markdown:
- DECIDED: Transcript observations use a dedicated ingest path (`apply_transcript_discovery`), NOT synthetic `IngestHookEventCommand`s. **Why:** transcripts have no PID/event_id/shell context; faking them as hook events would contaminate the hook pipeline and force unused fields. **How to apply:** any future transcript semantic extensions (periodic re-scan, content-based state inference) should extend `apply_transcript_discovery` or add sibling methods — do NOT add more `HookEventType` variants for non-hook signals.
- DECIDED: `from_storage_with_transcript_cold_start()` is a separate constructor from `from_storage()`. **Why:** tests using in-memory storage (`CoreRuntime::new()`) would otherwise scan real `~/.claude/projects/` and break isolation (found by 55-vs-1 test failure during implementation). **How to apply:** only persistent-snapshot constructors (`new_with_snapshot_file`) call the cold-start variant; in-memory/test runtimes skip the scan.
- CONSTRAINT: 6 existing fragmented transcript consumers still read transcripts directly — NOT yet migrated onto the new service. Rust: `runtime_stats.rs` (token counting), `runtime/projects.rs` (session enumeration), `core_query.rs::get_suggested_projects` (unpinned discovery). Swift: `ProjectCreationCoordinator.swift` (in-progress polling), `DelegationLoopManager.swift` (resume discovery), `SessionSummarizer.swift` (AI summarization tail-read). Each has divergent semantics; plan one follow-up slice per consumer.
- RULED OUT: Periodic transcript re-scan (deferred to Phase 4). Cold-start seeds once; sessions created after boot without hooks remain invisible until next restart.
- RULED OUT: Cold-start telemetry/logging (deferred to Phase 4 signal-health step). `let _ = state.apply_transcript_discovery(discovery)` currently drops `MutationOutcome` in cold-start loop.
narrative.goal: Pick up ADR-005 Phase 3 Q4 (evidence replay, now unblocked by Phase 2), Phase 4 hardening (telemetry/hook contract/signal-health), or migrate the 6 legacy transcript consumers onto the new observation::transcript service.
